name: The Skinnerkin
inspire: If you have 3 or more haunch tokens, Inspire each friendly fighter.
generalRules: You can use 1 of the following abilities per turn.

reactions.name: Prime Cuts
reactions.rulesText:
Immediately after a Flanked or Surrounded enemy fighter is slain, gain a haunch token.

Immediately after a friendly chef's ({icon:chef}) successful Attack, gain a haunch token.

If a friendly fighter's weapon has the {icon:fillet} runemark, you have access to the following Weapon ability:

Fillet {icon:fillet}: If the Attack was successful, gain a haunch token.

reactions.name: Grasping Talons
reactions.trigger: Use this immediately after a friendly Carnskyr Moves.
reactions.rulesText: Pick an enemy fighter in a hex that the Carnskyr moved through and roll an Attack dice. On a {icon:crit} or {icon:hammer}, inflict 1 damage on that fighter and gain a haunch token. Otherwise, you can push that fighter up to 1 hex.

abilities.name: Taste Test
abilities.trigger: Use this immediately after you resolve a Core ability for a friendly fighter.
abilities.flavorText: To earn the nod of approval from Gristla Tenderhooke is the dream of all ghoul butchers.
abilities.rulesText: Discard a haunch token and then Inspire a friendly fighter.

abilities.name: This One is Ruined; Fetch Me Another!
abilities.trigger: Use this immediately after making an Attack roll for a friendly fighter.
abilities.flavorText: Madam Tenderhooke is a discerning culinary artist; she will only accept the very best for her beloved king's tables.
abilities.rulesText: Discard a haunch token and then re-roll 1 Attack dice in that Attack roll.

abilities.name: The King Hungers!
abilities.trigger: Use this immediately after you pick a melee weapon as part of an Attack.
abilities.flavorText: Sometimes, fine filleting cuts are required from a chef. And sometimes, a less... subtle approach is needed.
abilities.rulesText: Discard a haunch token. That weapon has Grievous ({icon:grievous}) for that Attack.

abilities.name: Quick Nibble
abilities.trigger: Use this in your opponent's Power step.
abilities.flavorText: Well, you can hardly serve royalty something you wouldn't eat yourself, can you?
abilities.rulesText: Discard a haunch token and pick a friendly fighter. Heal that fighter.

playstyle: Five fragile ghoul butchers with low health and single-dice saves, but good speed and a flying Carnskyr minion that rakes enemies it passes over. Chefs harvest haunch tokens from successful Attacks, filleting strikes and slaying Flanked or Surrounded foes, then spend them on re-rolls, Grievous hits, healing and Inspiring fighters. Reaching three haunch tokens Inspires the whole warband at once, so they win by ganging up on isolated targets, feeding the token engine and snowballing into an empowered butchery crew.
